name: End To End Testing Checklist
description: This module is a pre-completion checklist for end to end testing work: a short set of checks to run before calling a end to end testing task done.
content:
This module is a pre-completion checklist for end to end testing work: a short set of checks to run before calling a end to end testing task done.

CORE GUIDELINES
1. When multiple end to end testing strategies are viable, name the trade-off explicitly rather than silently picking one.
2. Re-check edge cases relevant to end to end testing (empty input, boundary values, concurrent access) before calling the task done.
3. Keep end to end testing outputs reproducible: fix seeds, record versions, and avoid hidden non-determinism where it matters.
4. Before starting end to end testing work, confirm the scope and constraints so the approach matches the actual requirement.
5. Measure before optimizing any end to end testing bottleneck; do not guess at what is slow.
6. Document any non-obvious end to end testing decision with a short rationale so future readers understand the 'why', not just the 'what'.
7. When end to end testing decisions are ambiguous, favor the option that is easiest to reverse or extend later.
8. Prefer the simplest end to end testing approach that satisfies the requirement over a more general one that isn't needed yet.
9. Validate end to end testing outputs against a concrete example before treating the work as complete.

COMMON PITFALLS TO AVOID
- Do not skip documenting end to end testing assumptions just because they seem obvious in the moment.
- Do not silently drop end to end testing edge cases to make an example look cleaner than the real system.
- Avoid mixing unrelated end to end testing concerns into a single change; keep each change focused.

CLOSING NOTE
These guidelines are a starting point for end to end testing, not an exhaustive rulebook — use judgment when a rule doesn't fit the situation.
